idea-plugin.name: AI Commit Message (Custom Model)
idea-plugin.description:
Generates a Git commit message from the changes selected in the Commit tool window, using your own model endpoint (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Moonshot, Ollama, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible gateway).

Adds a button next to the commit message field - the same place the GitHub Copilot commit button lives - so it keeps working when a Copilot subscription runs out of AI credits.

  • Configurable base URL, model name and API key
  • OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible request shapes
  • Uses the platform's own patch builder for the diff, including new/untracked files
  • API key is stored in the IDE credential store, never in a plain-text file

action.description: Generate a commit message from the selected changes using your own model
